title: Solutions of a quadratic system
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $L$ be a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements, and let $w$ be an $n$-tuple over that field. Then $w$ satisfies $L$ exactly when it satisfies every equation in the list.
